Mozilla works with trusted service providers and partners to help deliver, maintain, and improve many of our products and websites, including Firefox and Mozilla accounts.

This list identifies entities that may process limited data in connection with these products and services, though it does not include all entities that Mozilla may engage across regions or operations and may be updated periodically.
{for fx154}
{note}'''Note:''' Some search providers are available by default only in select countries or regions. The search options you see in Firefox may vary depending on your location.{/note}
{/for}
